system_stages.name: Signals
system_stages.transformation: Timestamp, classify, and preserve source context

system_stages.name: Source of Truth
system_stages.transformation: Resolve entities, validate fields, link evidence, apply privacy controls
system_stages.output: Governed events, journeys, and evidence objects

system_stages.name: Health
system_stages.transformation: Calculate freshness, latency, completeness, and contradictions
system_stages.output: SLI-inspired indicators with explicit unknown states

system_stages.name: Intelligence
system_stages.input: Health state plus supporting and contradicting signals
system_stages.transformation: Weight evidence, expose uncertainty, freeze a falsifiable forecast
system_stages.output: Forecast window, confidence band, and change conditions

system_stages.name: Decision
system_stages.transformation: Frame tradeoffs, owner, rationale, and next action
system_stages.output: Act, monitor, investigate, escalate, close, or recalibrate

system_stages.name: Verification
system_stages.transformation: Score the miss or hit, test explanations, update a new model version
system_stages.output: Outcome record, calibration note, and preventive action

model_versions.description: Transparent review model; no scoring is produced until observed event data exists.

indicators.name: Evidence freshness
indicators.definition: Days since the most recent observed, public-safe event for an active journey.
indicators.decision_rule: If older than five days, review for a missing signal before changing journey health.

indicators.name: Signal-to-action latency
indicators.definition: Elapsed time between a qualifying observed signal and a recorded decision.
indicators.decision_rule: Investigate stalled decision ownership when the threshold is exceeded.

indicators.name: Evidence completeness
indicators.definition: Share of required evidence fields populated for the current journey state.
indicators.decision_rule: Do not create a forecast when required lineage fields are missing.

indicators.name: Contradiction rate
indicators.definition: Share of active assessments with unresolved evidence conflicts.
indicators.decision_rule: Move to investigate; preserve both claims until stronger evidence resolves the conflict.

indicators.name: Forecast calibration
indicators.definition: Agreement between frozen forecast confidence and later observed outcomes.
indicators.target: Calibrate after a meaningful verified sample
indicators.decision_rule: Show no calibration score until enough forecasts have observed outcomes.

lighthouse_candidates.name: Confirmed stage advancement
lighthouse_candidates.why: Direct evidence that the journey state changed; materially changes the next expected event.
lighthouse_candidates.decision: Update journey stage and refresh the forecast only after evidence is linked.

lighthouse_candidates.name: Direct scheduling event
lighthouse_candidates.why: A dated commitment is more decision-relevant than general interest or sentiment.
lighthouse_candidates.reliability: High when tied to a calendar or direct message
lighthouse_candidates.decision: Act on preparation and freeze a time-window forecast.

lighthouse_candidates.name: Public role-status change
lighthouse_candidates.why: A verifiable external change can challenge an internal assumption about journey health.
lighthouse_candidates.decision: Investigate before closing or escalating the journey.

synthetic_checks.name: Public role URL reachable
synthetic_checks.meaning: Tests whether a registered public role page still responds; it does not prove hiring status.

synthetic_checks.name: Journey exceeds expected window
synthetic_checks.meaning: Flags an active journey whose last observed event is older than its configured threshold.

synthetic_checks.name: Evidence sources disagree
synthetic_checks.meaning: Surfaces conflicting claims without automatically selecting a winner.

synthetic_checks.name: Forecast past due
synthetic_checks.meaning: Finds forecasts whose verification window passed without an observed outcome.

domain_patterns.measure: Tracking adoption, cycle-time, and data-quality signals

domain_patterns.measure: Source coverage, planning variance, and readiness state

cadence.activity: Ingest and classify a new observation
cadence.control: Preserve source, timestamp, evidence state, and privacy before use
Resolve missing fields; never infer an observed event from silence
Examine threshold breaches, contradictions, and open decisions
Freeze the original forecast; write the outcome separately
Create a new model version with a documented reason

human_ai_loop.control: Retain the original evidence object and confidentiality flag
Record model version, task class, source IDs, and created time
Reject unsupported claims and preserve contradictions
Label model-produced output as derived or hypothesis
Approve, revise, or reject before a decision is recorded
Verify against an observed result and update only a new model version

limitations: The current review build contains no private recruiter, interview, email, calendar, or application-event data.
This is personal/process data, not production-service telemetry; CUJ, SLI, SLO, error-budget, and synthetic-monitoring concepts are used as careful analogies.
Forecasts are decision-support hypotheses, not guarantees. No calibration score is shown without a meaningful set of verified outcomes.
Correlation does not establish causation; competing explanations remain visible when evidence cannot resolve them.
LLM output cannot become observed fact without source evidence and human validation.
Portfolio mechanisms are user-provided, public-safe evidence; they are not independently audited by this page.
